title: (0Day) Microsoft Azure MCP AzureCliService Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft Azure. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the azure-cli-mcp component. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the MCP server.
